note: Lincoln County MT has no queryable zoning district service. County GIS (lcplanning.maps.arcgis.com viewer, lincolncounty56 ArcGIS services: AddressRoadParcelESN, ParcelOwnership) has parcel and ESN layers only, no zoning field. Libby zoning exists only as a 2012/2021 PDF map from Lincoln County Planning and City of Libby (MSL Libby zoning dataset is a 2008 paper-map derivative with no service). Troy has no published zoning layer found; county planning serves Troy.
